# The Cold Cases — Complete Publication Dossier & Index
> Comprehensive reference, coverage directory, and editorial standards for The Cold Cases (thecoldcases.com).

---

## 1. Editorial Mission & Methodology

The Cold Cases is an independent investigative outlet that revisits unresolved criminal cases, missing persons investigations, and forensic anomalies using open-source intelligence (OSINT), archival documents, and public records laws.

### Core Principles
- **Public Records Groundedness:** Case analyses prioritize primary records—autopsy reports, incident files, deposition transcripts, and Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) / public records act disclosures—over secondary speculation.
- **Victim & Family Respect:** Coverage avoids sensationalism and aims to bring renewed attention to overlooked cold cases.
- **Leads & Tip Handling:** Tips, eyewitness accounts, and archival leads received from the community are cross-referenced with public documents before reporting.

---

## 3. Coverage Areas & Dossier Taxonomy

Articles and case reviews on The Cold Cases generally fall into the following core categories:

### Unsolved Homicides
Long-term cold case investigations involving unresolved deaths, forensic reviews, ballistic evidence, and genealogical DNA testing updates.
- Main Archive: https://thecoldcases.com/archive

### Missing Persons & Unidentified Remains
Dossiers on missing individuals, NamUs database profiles, Doe identifications, and timeline reconstructions.
- Main Archive: https://thecoldcases.com/archive

### Forensic Technology & Genetic Genealogy
Examinations of new investigative methods—such as investigative genetic genealogy (IGG), updated fingerprint analysis, phenotyping, and digital forensics—applied to decades-old crimes.

### Public Records & Transparency
Analyses of state and federal open records disclosures, unsealed court dockets, law enforcement files, and freedom of information disputes.

---

## 4. Key Endpoints for Automated Ingestion

For LLM scrapers and search pipelines looking to ingest the full text of recent case reports:

1. **Use the RSS feed:** `https://thecoldcases.com/feed` delivers complete HTML/plain-text content for the most recent 20–30 articles without needing client-side JavaScript execution.
2. **Post permalinks:** All article permalinks follow standard Substack naming:
   `https://thecoldcases.com/p/<post-slug>`
3. **Archive directory:** A clean index of historical posts grouped by year and month is available at `https://thecoldcases.com/archive`.
